headline: Ramayana is expected to sell about 24K tickets in the 12–1 AM hour, with today projected near 2.22M and tomorrow near 1.15M.
bullets: The busiest hour still ahead, 12–1 AM, is expected at 24K tickets for Ramayana (range 21K to 27K), then easing to 14.3K and 4.4K in the next two hours.
Today (Sun 8 Nov, Diwali listed) is projected at 2.22M tickets (range 2.12M to 2.31M) after 917K so far, 27% above yesterday.
Tomorrow, a weekday (Mon 9 Nov), is expected at 1.15M tickets (range 844K to 1.54M), based on the usual Sun-to-Mon change across films.

Ramayana is on its opening weekend (release day number 3) and no review or word-of-mouth signals are switched on, so the forecast is not nudged (0%); review and word-of-mouth information is only collected for films that are switched on.
watch: If review or word-of-mouth signals are switched on, they could lean this estimate by up to about +16% or -18%.
Next-hour counts have typically landed between x0.87 and x1.12 of the estimate, so the 12–1 AM figure could move.
